_comment: One entry per conference. `corpus` is the single most important field: it says what the visible papers actually are, because that changes what every chart means. Check it with scripts/fetch.py --probe before trusting a new venue.

iclr.corpus_note: ICLR publishes every submission, so counts measure what the field submits.
iclr.name: ICLR

neurips.corpus_note: NeurIPS publishes accepted papers plus a small opted-in minority of rejections (~5%). Counts measure what was ACCEPTED, not what was submitted. Acceptance rates and withdrawal rates cannot be computed. NeurIPS also changed its rating scale between 2024 (1-10) and 2025 (1-6); scores are not comparable across those years.
neurips.name: NeurIPS

icml.corpus_note: As NeurIPS. ICML 2024 and earlier carry no keywords, primary_area or public reviews, so they are excluded.
icml.name: ICML
